Yes. The extra friction may reduce meaningless messages. It also helps us sort into better pipelines in our admin workflows, rather than treating all as the same. Another big win is potentially solving immediately with existing site resources, preventing the need to wait on a response at all. Pre-launch, I'd also like to build an AI help chatbot with all of our knowledge, build on a really cheap (maybe free) Vercel AI Gateway model provider with good intelligence. This would likely solve tons of would-be support tickets too. Maybe fixed in the screen bottom right corner? Libraries.dev (a library we pay for) has tons of cool effects for AI agent interaction design.
Is this asking if the note + link below the topic selector should be custom per potential topic selected? If so, yes, custom per topic instead of one generic 'try troubleshooting'.
The success state/transition could be much more polished. Design magic opportunity, or at least a small delight opportunity, here.

This resources UI could be designed to be a bit better. Maybe icons instead of numbers, make the email link white/heavier, for a start. The headings seem quite small and thin. That's another side note - I have no idea where the thin app heading weights (maybe on the h3, h4?) came into play, but it looks very bad compared to our standard heavier weight.
